# The checks a pull request must pass before it can merge into main.
#
# GitHub enforces them through the protect-main ruleset's required_status_checks rule; this file is
# the list that rule is set from, and tests/unit/part19.py holds it to the workflows: every Actions
# check named here is a job of a workflow that runs on EVERY pull request (no path filter), so a
# required check can never wait forever on a workflow that did not run, and every job of those
# workflows is named here, so a new one is required or the build says so.
#
# When this list changes, set the rule from it (the app ids, read off the check runs: GitHub
# Actions 15368, codacy-production 56611, sonarqubecloud 12526):
#   gh api repos/FMSMITH91/linuxgsm-panel/rulesets/18871997 > rs.json, edit the
#   required_status_checks rule's "required_status_checks" list, then PUT it back.
#
# Fuzz and ClusterFuzzLite run on every pull request too, and pass at once when it changes nothing
# they fuzz (each job's scope step, the first after Harden-Runner, reads the pull request's file
# list). Not here, on purpose: Aikido's
# checks (its pull-request suite often never starts, which would hold every merge), GitHub's own
# code-scanning checks (CodeQL, Bandit, Semgrep OSS, zizmor: the "Open code-scanning alerts (PR)" job
# waits for each one's analysis of the pull request's merge commit and gates on what they find;
# ClusterFuzzLite/CIFuzz is not waited for, as it uploads only when fuzzed code changes, and a crash
# it finds fails the required "fuzz the diff" job instead), and Codacy's coverage checks.
#
# Not here YET, the owner's call: zizmor.yml's two jobs, "Workflow security (zizmor)" and "Upload
# zizmor results". They run on every pull request, so either can be added (here and in the ruleset).
# Until then zizmor still gates a merge: "Open code-scanning alerts (PR)" fails when its analysis of
# the merge commit is missing, or when it found anything.
#
# <app slug> | <check name>
github-actions | checks (ubuntu-22.04 · py3.10)
github-actions | checks (ubuntu-24.04 · py3.12)
github-actions | checks (ubuntu-26.04 · py3.14)
github-actions | coverage
github-actions | js coverage

github-actions | gamedig lockfile (node 22)
github-actions | gamedig lockfile (node 24)

github-actions | Analyze (javascript)
github-actions | Analyze (actions)
